name: 86 Chaos 16.0.56 Schedule Delete Visibility Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.56 Schedule Delete Visibility Fix
notes: Fixes Schedule Builder so deleted shifts are removed from the visible grid immediately while the Firestore listener catches up.
releaseNotes: Schedule Builder now hides successfully deleted shifts immediately, including optimistic shift echoes and pending auto-fill preview records.
Local delete markers prevent a just-deleted shift from flashing back onto the grid while Firestore snapshots settle.
The fix is scoped to schedule visibility and does not change Firebase rules, indexes, credentials, pricing, or app design.
